summary: PyroGlyph is an interactive, super intelligence-powered dashboard built to decode decades of NASA microgravity combustion data. In reduced-gravity environments like the Moon, Mars, and deep-space transit vehicles, flames behave unpredictably, forming spherical diffusion flames, lingering at low oxygen levels, and creating unique fire hazards that Earth-based safety models miss. PyroGlyph solves the challenge of sifting through massive experimental datasets by allowing users to input or load combustion parameters (such as ambient pressure, oxygen concentration, fuel type, and airflow velocity). Its SI engine automatically detects anomalies, identifies hidden behavioral patterns, ranks fire-risk factors, and translates raw scientific telemetry into clear, actionable fire safety protocols for future human space exploration. Spending valuable time and precious resources on collecting data is useless when that data cannot be processed. PyroGlyph aims to solve that problem seamlessly.
details:
Pyroglyph: Microgravity Combustion Telemetry & Fire Safety Dashboard

  • What it does & How it works: Pyroglyph is an interactive, super intelligence-powered dashboard built for the NASA Space Apps "Flame in Freefall" challenge. It ingests historical microgravity combustion datasets (from the ISS Combustion Integrated Rack and FLEX/SOFIE experiments) or custom CSV files to simulate and analyze flame behavior, oxygen flammability limits, and forced ventilation risks in space.
  • Tech Stack & Tools: Built using a high-performance, zero-backend architecture with HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, and Chart.js for real-time telemetry plotting.
  • Impact & Benefits: Translates complex space-flight combustion physics into actionable fire-suppression and safety protocols, safeguarding future crewed missions on the Moon and Mars habitats.
